The 'Tradition' broad emphasisRewards and single-active-deity gate wording below are the pre-reconciliation model, kept for record. design-draft-2026-06-07; recognition V1 Survey/status only; P2 audit-only (no new reward volume beyond gate/ledger); pending authoring run
notes: Authoritative record spec for the Breton tradition pilot. BUDGET VERDICT = Overstack Risk; discipline is the point. GATE TYPE = STATE-enum-gated (R7): rewards gate on PDV_State_BretonTradition (KnightsRoad=0 | HiddenArt=1 | GreenWay=2) plus the active tradition's focused patron tier within that state. ONLY the active tradition's focused reward family pays at a time (the other two are suppressed) -- this is the Overstack Risk control. BROAD LANE = the Tradition STATE, not a deity (R1): broad T1 fills the FIXED manager property PDV_Bless_Breton_Tradition_T1 (R2) granted via PATRON_STATE_BROAD; broad T2 is PDV_Bless_Breton_Tradition_T2 (new). NO flat Breton pantheon or generic broad-worship deity. Breton OWNS NO Aedric deities (R5): Knight's Road focuses REUSE Imperial-owned Divines where applicable; Hidden Art reuses existing PDV_Deity_Magnus for benign magic and PDV_Deity_Mara for hearth/home/cover rows; Julianos is Knight's Road study-law only. Green Way routes to existing Y'ffre. Kynareth is removed from Green Way offer/reward ownership and any former Green Way Kynareth proxy/source/payout item routes to Y'ffre. Phynaster is proof-gated and not authored here until a concrete pilgrimage/endurance plus elven-heritage hook package is accepted. Hidden Art Daedric forks and Green Way werewolf/Daedric forks route through the existing Phase 20C Daedric system (R6) -- NO new records here. THREE STANDING TRACKS (KnightlyVowIntegrity, WitchcraftExposure, DruidicStanding) are PRESSURE ONLY: they modify access/penalty/rupture and NEVER pay a second or third always-on boon family; they must not all pay positive rewards at once. Hidden Art focused rewards are stronger ONLY because WitchcraftExposure/rupture/Vigilant pressure is the price (magnitude conditioned on visible exposure cost). T3 NPC recognition is V1-deferred (PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md); V1 T3 ships stat/signature effects with Champion Survey text as the recognition surface. Player-facing text is ASCII-only and uses Skyrim ActorValue names. No magnitude exceeds ~12%. Broad stays softer than focused.

The tradition Survey reports the active PDV_State_BretonTradition spine, KnightlyVowIntegrity/WitchcraftExposure/DruidicStanding bands, PDV_State_BretonDruidicFork, curse posture, and WHY parallel tradition rewards are not all active. budget: Two always-on families only: broad Tradition lane (Layer 1, capped at T2/Faithful) + the ONE active tradition's focused family (Layer 2, T1/T2/T3, selected by PDV_State_BretonTradition). The other two focused families are suppressed. The three standing tracks (KnightlyVowIntegrity/WitchcraftExposure/DruidicStanding) MODIFY access/penalty/rupture and are NOT a third buff track; they must not all pay positive rewards at once. Hidden Art is the strongest focused family ONLY because WitchcraftExposure/rupture/Vigilant pressure is its price. At the PDV_RaceRewardBudgetLedger Breton ceiling: 'One tradition spine plus one focused patron within it; cross-track pressure modifies or penalizes but adds no extra always-on boon family.' No magnitude exceeds ~12%. Broad stays softer than every focused family.
